product_attribute_values_typed_payload.name: product_attribute_values_typed_payload
product_attribute_values_typed_payload.value: ("product_attribute_values"."data_type"='text' AND "product_attribute_values"."text_value" IS NOT NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."number_value" IS NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."boolean_value" IS NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."enum_value" IS NULL) OR ("product_attribute_values"."data_type"='number' AND "product_attribute_values"."number_value" IS NOT NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."text_value" IS NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."boolean_value" IS NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."enum_value" IS NULL) OR ("product_attribute_values"."data_type"='boolean' AND "product_attribute_values"."boolean_value" IS NOT NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."text_value" IS NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."number_value" IS NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."enum_value" IS NULL) OR ("product_attribute_values"."data_type"='enum' AND "product_attribute_values"."enum_value" IS NOT NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."text_value" IS NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."number_value" IS NULL AND "product_attribute_values"."boolean_value" IS NULL)

product_variants_measurements_valid.name: product_variants_measurements_valid
product_variants_measurements_valid.value: ("product_variants"."weight_grams" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."weight_grams">0) AND ("product_variants"."length_mm" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."length_mm">0) AND ("product_variants"."width_mm" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."width_mm">0) AND ("product_variants"."height_mm" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."height_mm">0)

carts_actor_valid.name: carts_actor_valid
carts_actor_valid.value: ("carts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "carts"."guest_token_hash" IS NULL) OR ("carts"."user_id" IS NULL AND "carts"."guest_token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

carts_actor_present.name: carts_actor_present
carts_actor_present.value: "carts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "carts"."guest_token_hash" IS NOT NULL

carts_fields_valid.name: carts_fields_valid
carts_fields_valid.value: "carts"."currency"='KZT' AND length(btrim("carts"."market"))>0 AND "carts"."version">0 AND "carts"."line_epoch">=0 AND "carts"."expires_at">"carts"."created_at" AND "carts"."status" IN ('active','converted','merged','expired')

carts_merge_valid.name: carts_merge_valid
carts_merge_valid.value: ("carts"."status"='merged' AND "carts"."merged_into_cart_id" IS NOT NULL AND "carts"."merged_into_cart_id"<>"carts"."id") OR ("carts"."status"<>'merged' AND "carts"."merged_into_cart_id" IS NULL)

checkout_attempts_fields_valid.name: checkout_attempts_fields_valid
checkout_attempts_fields_valid.value: "checkout_attempts"."cart_version">0 AND length(btrim("checkout_attempts"."actor_scope"))>0 AND "checkout_attempts"."operation"='checkout' AND "checkout_attempts"."idempotency_key" ~ '^[ -~]{16,128}$' AND "checkout_attempts"."request_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "checkout_attempts"."status" IN ('pending','committed','failed')

checkout_quotes_amounts_valid.name: checkout_quotes_amounts_valid
checkout_quotes_amounts_valid.value: "checkout_quotes"."subtotal_minor">=0 AND "checkout_quotes"."discount_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "checkout_quotes"."subtotal_minor" AND "checkout_quotes"."shipping_minor">=0 AND "checkout_quotes"."tax_minor">=0 AND "checkout_quotes"."total_minor"="checkout_quotes"."subtotal_minor"-"checkout_quotes"."discount_minor"+"checkout_quotes"."shipping_minor"+"checkout_quotes"."tax_minor"

checkout_quotes_fields_valid.name: checkout_quotes_fields_valid
checkout_quotes_fields_valid.value: "checkout_quotes"."currency"='KZT' AND "checkout_quotes"."display_currency" IN ('KZT','USD') AND "checkout_quotes"."cart_version">0 AND "checkout_quotes"."expires_at">"checkout_quotes"."created_at" AND ("checkout_quotes"."cart_hash" IS NULL OR "checkout_quotes"."cart_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

checkout_quotes_json_valid.name: checkout_quotes_json_valid
checkout_quotes_json_valid.value: jsonb_typeof("checkout_quotes"."contact_snapshot")='object' AND jsonb_typeof("checkout_quotes"."delivery_snapshot")='object' AND jsonb_typeof("checkout_quotes"."lines_snapshot")='array' AND jsonb_typeof("checkout_quotes"."policy_versions")='object' AND ("checkout_quotes"."usd_snapshot" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("checkout_quotes"."usd_snapshot")='object')

order_access_tokens_valid.name: order_access_tokens_valid
order_access_tokens_valid.value: "order_access_tokens"."token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "order_access_tokens"."scope" IN ('order_status','order_receipt') AND "order_access_tokens"."expires_at">"order_access_tokens"."created_at" AND ("order_access_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR "order_access_tokens"."revoked_at">="order_access_tokens"."created_at")

order_addresses_shape_valid.name: order_addresses_shape_valid
order_addresses_shape_valid.value: ("order_addresses"."kind"='structured' AND "order_addresses"."recipient_name" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("order_addresses"."recipient_name"))>0 AND "order_addresses"."phone" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("order_addresses"."phone"))>0 AND "order_addresses"."country_code" IS NOT NULL AND "order_addresses"."country_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' AND "order_addresses"."city" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("order_addresses"."city"))>0 AND "order_addresses"."line1" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("order_addresses"."line1"))>0 AND "order_addresses"."legacy_raw" IS NULL) OR ("order_addresses"."kind"='legacy_unstructured' AND "order_addresses"."legacy_raw" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("order_addresses"."legacy_raw"))>0 AND "order_addresses"."recipient_name" IS NULL AND "order_addresses"."phone" IS NULL AND "order_addresses"."country_code" IS NULL AND "order_addresses"."city" IS NULL AND "order_addresses"."line1" IS NULL AND "order_addresses"."line2" IS NULL AND "order_addresses"."region" IS NULL AND "order_addresses"."postal_code" IS NULL)

order_events_valid.name: order_events_valid
order_events_valid.value: length(btrim("order_events"."type"))>0 AND length(btrim("order_events"."source"))>0 AND length(btrim("order_events"."dedupe_key"))>0 AND "order_events"."visibility" IN ('internal','customer') AND jsonb_typeof("order_events"."payload")='object'

order_items_fields_valid.name: order_items_fields_valid
order_items_fields_valid.value: "order_items"."quantity">0 AND length(btrim("order_items"."name"))>0 AND ("order_items"."variant_id" IS NULL OR "order_items"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) AND jsonb_typeof("order_items"."options")='object' AND jsonb_typeof("order_items"."legacy_source")='object'

orders_fields_valid.name: orders_fields_valid
orders_fields_valid.value: length(btrim("orders"."order_number"))>0 AND length(btrim("orders"."contact_name"))>0 AND "orders"."currency"='KZT' AND "orders"."data_quality" IN ('complete','legacy_incomplete') AND "orders"."version">0

orders_statuses_valid.name: orders_statuses_valid
orders_statuses_valid.value: "orders"."order_status" IN ('pending_payment','confirmed','cancel_requested','cancelled','closed') AND "orders"."payment_status" IN ('unpaid','pending','authorized','paid','partially_refunded','refunded','failed') AND "orders"."fulfillment_status" IN ('unfulfilled','processing','partially_shipped','shipped','delivered','exception') AND "orders"."payment_mode" IN ('demo','live','legacy_unknown')

orders_amounts_valid.name: orders_amounts_valid
orders_amounts_valid.value: "orders"."total_minor">=0 AND ("orders"."subtotal_minor" IS NULL OR "orders"."subtotal_minor">=0) AND ("orders"."discount_minor" IS NULL OR "orders"."discount_minor">=0) AND ("orders"."shipping_minor" IS NULL OR "orders"."shipping_minor">=0) AND ("orders"."tax_minor" IS NULL OR "orders"."tax_minor">=0) AND ("orders"."shipping_tax_minor" IS NULL OR "orders"."shipping_tax_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "orders"."tax_minor") AND ("orders"."subtotal_minor" IS NULL OR "orders"."discount_minor" IS NULL OR "orders"."discount_minor"<="orders"."subtotal_minor")

orders_complete_fields.name: orders_complete_fields
orders_complete_fields.value: "orders"."data_quality"<>'complete' OR ("orders"."contact_phone" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("orders"."contact_phone"))>0 AND "orders"."placed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."subtotal_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."discount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."shipping_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."tax_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."total_minor"="orders"."subtotal_minor"-"orders"."discount_minor"+"orders"."shipping_minor"+"orders"."tax_minor")

customer_profiles_complete_fields.name: customer_profiles_complete_fields
customer_profiles_complete_fields.value: "customer_profiles"."profile_state"<>'complete' OR ("customer_profiles"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_profiles"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_profiles"."normalized_phone" IS NOT NULL)

users_verified_phone_only.name: users_verified_phone_only
users_verified_phone_only.value: ("users"."phone_number" IS NULL AND NOT "users"."phone_number_verified") OR ("users"."phone_number" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."phone_number" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$' AND "users"."phone_number_verified")

inventory_reservations_valid.name: inventory_reservations_valid
inventory_reservations_valid.value: "inventory_reservations"."version">0 AND "inventory_reservations"."expires_at">"inventory_reservations"."created_at" AND (("inventory_reservations"."status"='active' AND "inventory_reservations"."ended_at" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_reservations"."status" IN ('consumed','released','expired') AND "inventory_reservations"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_reservations"."ended_at">="inventory_reservations"."created_at"))

media_assets_dimensions_valid.name: media_assets_dimensions_valid
media_assets_dimensions_valid.value: ("media_assets"."width" IS NULL AND "media_assets"."height" IS NULL) OR ("media_assets"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."width">0 AND "media_assets"."height">0)

media_assets_ready_metadata.name: media_assets_ready_metadata
media_assets_ready_metadata.value: "media_assets"."status"<>'ready' OR ("media_assets"."byte_size" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."checksum_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."mime_type" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("media_assets"."mime_type"))>0)

public.phone_identities.definition: SELECT id AS user_id, phone_number FROM users WHERE phone_number_verified = true
public.phone_identities.name: phone_identities
